tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bye ri stag rtser zla gsang gi bsnyen sgrub zhig bgyis pa'i tshe 'khrul snang du byung ba bden par bzung nas bris pa bzhugs so//

lcags pho 'brug lo cho 'phrul chen po'i yar tshes gnyis kyi nub nas bzung bye ri stag rtser zla gsang bsnyen sgrub ngag mtshams shin tu dam pa zhig bgyis pa'i skabs/ tshes gsum gyi nub rmi lam du rtse ba yin rgyu ba zhig tu bande ngo mi shes pa mang po'i khrod du bdag 'dug pa la/ bande zhig gis bdag la khyod da lo 'chi ba 'dug shi ba'i tshe khyod kyi phung po 'di na 'jog rgyu yin zer nas shing khri zhig la mdzub mo 'dzugs kyi 'dug par/ bdag gi bsam par 'di tsho rgyal 'gong yin 'dug /bdag sgam pa'i phyir smra yi bdag gis kyang bcos te smra'o snyam ste kho bo da lta shi yang sla yi kho bo'i ro shing khri'i steng du 'jog mi dgos khyod rang rnams zo zhig ces smras pas yang de dag na re/ khyod 'das nas zhag bcu phrag gi bar du gzhan la gsang dgos 'dug /khyod nges par da lo 'chi'o 'chi'o zer bas/ bdag gis kho bo shi nas bskal pa ma zhig gi bar du gsang na'ang gsongs ji ltar dga' bar gyis shig smras pas ngo gnong pa ltar byas nas sor sor deng song*/ tshes lnga'i nub dam sel dang nyams grib kyi ltas kha yar byung*/ tshes drug phyi ma'i nyin nyang po sang sing du long po'i dmag byung ba thos pas rkyen pa ltar/ de nub nam srod la 'tshub che tsam byung rjes nam gung gi thun grub rjes rmi lam du khang pa ngo mi shes pa zhig tu bdag bsdad pa'i zla bo yang mang du 'dug par phyogs nas dmag zhig yong rgyu ba la/ dmag byung tshe ra ba'i nang du tsher ma brtsegs pa mang po 'dug pa yang bdag tshos bsrung dgos pa'i lugs byed 'dug par ban dmag mang po lhags byung ba'i tshe bande gtsod ru thogs pa seṅge'i mgo can zhig byung bar/ bdag gis khyod dmag la 'ong na lag cha mi 'dug pa zhes smras pas gtsod ru de bstan nas bdag gi lag cha 'di yin/ khyod kyi lag cha gang yin zhes zer bar bdag gi lag tu phur bu dang rnga zhig gdengs nas/

kho bo'i lag cha 'di ka yin no zhes smras nas bdag gi bsam pa la ban dmag 'di rnams la zla gsang gi rgyud kyi nad ngan gtong ba ma mo'i zla gsang gi skabs de bya'o snyam sngags bzlas shing las sbyor byas ma thag bande seng ge'i mgo can de sgo 'gag tu brang rdung gi 'dug pa ci byung byas pas dmag thams cad khrag nad kyis shi song nga yang ji lta bu byed zer 'o dod 'bod 'dug pa/ sgo 'gag tu bltas pas ban dmag rnams phal cher khrag skyug cing bshal nas kha sbubs dang gan rkyal du 'dug nas shi zin 'dug go// yang de ma thag nam mkha' nas 'brug sgra dang thog ser mang du bab byung bar phur bu gdengs shing sdigs mdzub byas pas de dag phyogs gzhan du song yang ri 'bur zhig gi rtser mchod rten zhig thog gis bshigs song ba brtags pas bdag la mi gnod par go// tho rangs bzlas pa byas pa'i tshe nam langs su cha ba'i tshe gnyid la thum tsam song ba na rmi lam du bdag gis rta dmar po shin tu legs pa zhig zhon nas khang pa mang po'i thog tu 'gro 'dug pa'i bsam pa la gal te 'di rmi lam du 'dug /bdag ngag mtshams yin par rta zhon nas 'gro rgyu gar yong rmi lam 'di gar sgyur kyang btub pas nam mkha'i mthongs su rta rgyug bya'o snyam nas nam mkha' la rta rgyug pas thang la rta rgyug pa khyad med byung bas yang bsam par/ rmi lam yin pa yang nam mkhar rta rgyug pa mi yong 'di ni theg chen rta la zhon nas nam mkhar 'gro ba bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags bzang po nges par yin no snyam pa'i tshe gzugs med pa'i skad chen pos de de ltar yin no zhes zer ma thag gnyid sad pa zhig byung*/ tshes bdun gyi nub mo khams nyog cing sde brgyad tshogs pa'i zang zing mang ba tsam las 'di yin ma byung*/ tshes brgyad kyi nam gung thun btang nas nyal ba'i tshe/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin ston pas rdzu 'phrul gyis mu stegs thams cad pham par byas pa'i dus khyad par can yin snyam sems dad pa cher goms bzhin du gnyid la song ma thag

/rmi lam du sa yul ngo mi shes pa zhig tu grong khyer chen po'i dbus su seṅge'i khri chen po'i steng du bdag cag gi ston pa bzhugs/ de'i mthar dge 'dun mang po dang rgyal po dang khyim bdag pho mo grangs kyis mi lang bas bskor/ nye logs su mu stegs gi ston pa yin rgyu ba'i gcer bu skra bcing pa dang snyeg pa mang du tshogs 'dug par| de'i mod ston pas cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa bstan pas mu stegs de rnams tshar bcad pa zhig rmis pas 'di rmi lam du 'dug /cho 'phrul bstan pa'i bshad pa rnams su tshes brgyad kyi nyin mu stegs tshar bcad pa'i sems rmis su 'dug /'on kyang ston pa dang mjal ba skal pa bzang snyam pa byung*/ tshes dgu dang bcu sogs la rmi lam zang zing mang zhing gzhi bdag ngo mi shes pa mang po 'khrug cing 'thab pa sogs mang du byung*/ tshes bcu gsum gyi nub bsnyen sgrub kyi ltas zla ba thang la lhung ba sogs 'ga' zhig rmis/ tshes bcu bzhi dang bco lnga la yi dam gyi sku'i snang brnyan dang de nyid mthong bzhin par yi dam gzhan rnams yid la byas na de'i skur snang ba sogs mang ba zhig byung zhing rmi lam cher ma rmis/ tshes bco lnga'i nub kyang sde brgyad kyi tshub cha mang zhing lhag par 'di phyogs su gre bo rgyal 'gong dang chu 'dre sogs mang bar 'dug pas thams cad kyis tshub ston pa'ang byung*/ tshes bcu dgu'i nub phyi nang gi gdon po 'ga' zhig tshar bcad zer ba'i mtshan ma dang khyad par dregs pa las la tshud pa'i mtshan ma 'ga' zung byung*/ tshes nyi shu'i nyi nub thams cad du'ang khams 'dus pa'i zos ma bde ba zhig byung bas yi dam la gsol ba btab pas/ 'jam dbyangs zhi ba'i sku'i snang brnyan yud tsam mthong nas gnyid du song ba'i tshe gnyid mthug gi 'od gsal ngos bzung zhing stong gzhi lugs 'byung lugs zlog rnams kyang shin tu gsal ba ngos bzung bas/ da lta shi yang tshe snga phyi'i bar mtshams zhes ming tsam ma gtogs khang pa gcig nas gcig tu 'gro ba tsam du 'dug par yid ches nges pa rnyed pas da lta'i bar gnyid kyi stong gzhi thim rim ched du ngos 'dzin mi dgos par rang dbang 'du ba zhig byung*/

de nub 'od gsal las langs tshe rigs drug tu skyes pa'i gnas sbyong dpag tu med pa byung ba'i rmi lam dang nyams snang ches mang ba 'dug kyang ma bris so// nyer gcig gi nyin drang srong dri med zhi drag dang 'khor lo sdom pa sogs kyi yi dam mang po'i zhal mthong zhing*/ srod la rdor legs ra rgya bo zhig khrid nas slebs byung bas gang nas 'ong dris pas 'u yug nas 'ongs zer/ ci byed du 'ong dris pas nga 'di khyer nas 'ongs zer mi skya bo skra lo yod pa 'brum rjes cung zad la mig zur g.yon du rme ba yod pa/ pad 'dab shin tu che ba btags pa zhig phad bu'i nang du bcug 'dug pa bstan byung bas mi des bdag la 'o cag pho lhas khyer ba yin zer bas/ bdag gis dam can par the'u rang zhes pa phra men 'byung po'i nang nas kyang tha shal ba zhig yin pas/ khyod pho lhar bsten pa la 'di las 'os ci yod byas pas dam can kho rang kha skyengs pa ltar byed 'dug pa'i mur bdag kyang gnyid du song zhing*/ tho rangs rmi lam du btsun mo'i tshal gyi rgyal po slebs byung*/ ci byed du 'ong dris pas da dung gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud 'bum mang po 'dug rtsol ba byas nas khyer yong zer bas de ltar gyis shig ces smras/ nyer gnyis kyi nyin bsnyen sngags la sngags kyi sbyor ba byas pas tshub shin tu che ba dang de nub kyang yi dam dang sde brgyad kyi mtshan ma mang du byung zhing tho rangs sngags bzla ba'i tshe mdun du mi ro mang po gar byed cing glu len pa dang me chu 'khrugs pa sogs cho 'phrul gyi rnam pa mang du byung*/ nyer gnyis kyi nyin don grub bsnyen pa'i rgyas sdebs kyang bgyis shing de nyin dang de nub bar snang nas sngags kyi sgra sgrog pa dang*/ gtor mar me dang du ba sogs byung zhing*/ de nub srod dang gung thun la sde brgyad bye brag yul 'di'i lha 'dre mang pos bdud rtsi khar blang ba dang*/

sha khrag dang nor rdzas mang po phul ba'i rmi lam du ma byung zhing tho rangs dngos grub kyi cho ga bgyis nas nam langs tshe gnyid du thum tsam song tshe glegs bam mang po rtsar bab byung ba 'ga' zhig khar mid cing 'ga' zhig pang du blangs nas khyer ba sogs kyi mtshan ma byung*/ nyer gsum gyi snga dro gtor 'bul bgyis shing de nas mtshams rjes bsrungs pas de nub/ rang dang gzhan la dge ba dang mi dge ba'i lung bstan gyi mtshan ma mang ba rang zhig byung yang*/ rang cag mngon sum la'ang phyi nang thams cad kyis bden par 'dzin pa dkon na rmi lam gyi 'khrul pa bden par 'dzin pa lta zhog snyam pas ma bris so// gzhan yang lha 'dre'i mtshan ltas dang bzang ngan cho 'phrul dang lung gi rnam grangs ni sngon chad mtshams bsnyen byas pa thams cad las da lam mang ba rang zhig byung yang*| 'ga' zhig ni brjed ngas su yang thal la 'ga' zhig rang nyid ma gtogs gzhan la dgos pa chung bas ma bris shing*/ bsnyen sgrub rang gi rtsa ba'i rtags rnams ni gsang dgos par gsungs pas kyang bri bar ma spobs so// zhes pa yang ma byan gcung rgyal sras dge slong lha mo mched grogs sogs 'ga' zhig gis 'bri rogs dgos tshul nan tan gyis zer byung bas dus ngan 'di 'drar lab rigs mang ba rang la gnod pa'i rgyu dang*/ bdag la brten pas gzhan sdig gi rtsa bar 'dug kyang ngo ma chog pa thor bu rags rim tsam zhig zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis la bye ri stag rtse'i kun gsal gsang sngags kyi pho brang du mgyogs par bris pa yin no// //maṅga laṃ//
